cards.title: Harvard's AI Instructor Avatars Launch in Bootcamp
cards.body: Harvard Business School's HBS Foundry program now features AI avatars of instructors providing feedback during practice pitches and board meetings. The $699 startup bootcamp integrates AI-powered mentorship into its curriculum.

cards.title: DeepMind Alumni's Faraday Outperforms OpenAI, Anthropic
cards.body: British AI lab Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, released Faraday, an AI agent that outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific research. The breakthrough could accelerate AI-driven scientific innovation.

cards.title: OpenAI Reverses Position, Backs California AI Safety Bill
cards.body: OpenAI is now calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill it previously opposed. The shift signals growing industry consensus on regulatory measures.

cards.title: Leading AI Labs Lack Rogue Model Containment Plans
cards.body: A new study reveals frontier AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models. The finding raises concerns about preparedness as AI systems show increasingly unpredictable behavior.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found Claude's sexual content restrictions can be easily circumvented despite Anthropic's explicit safeguards. The gap highlights ongoing challenges in AI safety measures.

cards.title: Nvidia Partners with Cloverleaf on Data Centers
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding its data center investments through a partnership with developer Cloverleaf. The move capitalizes on surging AI infrastructure demand.

cards.title: AI Agent Performance Hinges on Harness, Not Model
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that fine-tuned harnesses matter more than base model quality for AI agent performance. The findings suggest architectural choices outweigh raw model capabilities.

cards.title: DOJ Investigates a16z Over Board Seat Conflicts
cards.body: The Department of Justice is investigating Andreessen Horowitz over potential conflicts involving two partners sitting on competing portfolio company boards. The probe raises questions about venture capital governance practices.

cards.title: Starcloud Raises $250M for Orbital Data Centers
cards.body: Starcloud secured $250 million to develop orbital data centers as traditional launch options become increasingly scarce. The startup taps growing demand for space-based AI infrastructure.

cards.title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Run Rate
cards.body: Data startup Micro1 reached $500 million in gross annual run rate amid explosive AI training data demand. The growth reflects intensifying competition for quality training datasets.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Enterprise Ground Against Anthropic
cards.body: New data shows OpenAI is overtaking Anthropic among business users as both labs release competing models. Enterprise AI spending shows high volatility as customers switch between providers.

cards.title: ChatGPT Now Drafts Texts via Apple Messages
cards.body: OpenAI's ChatGPT integration with Apple Messages lets users automatically generate and send text messages. The feature automates one more writing task via AI.

cards.title: Data Center Cooling Innovation: Alternative Water Sources
cards.body: Creative cooling solutions for data centers are gaining traction as water scarcity concerns grow. Alternative cooling methods could reduce infrastructure's environmental footprint.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Combat AI Search Traffic Loss
cards.body: Google launched a new feature letting readers designate preferred news sources across Search, Discover, and News. The tool helps publishers regain traffic lost to AI search redirects.

cards.title: Runlayer and Rippling Drop Lawsuits Without Settlement
cards.body: Runlayer and Rippling resolved their disputes by dropping lawsuits with no financial settlement. Rippling marked the truce by immediately launching a competing product.

cards.title: Linkdaze Smart Calendar Adds Free AI Meal Planner
cards.body: Linkdaze's digital calendar keeps AI features behind no paywall, including an AI meal planning tool. The approach prioritizes accessibility over premium monetization.

cards.title: Grok Lite Sends Gibberish Responses to Users
cards.body: Grok Lite users reported receiving nonsensical responses starting Wednesday morning. The issue highlights reliability challenges in emerging AI assistants.

cards.title: One-Third of Web Content Now AI-Generated
cards.body: A study finds that one-third of web pages published since ChatGPT launched were written by AI. ChatGPT and similar models now author and edit significant portions of new web content.

cards.title: Ramp Launches AI Model Router Service
cards.body: Ramp introduced Router, an API-based service that routes requests between different large language models. The tool lets users and companies seamlessly switch between various AI models.

cards.title: Meta Brings Pocket AI Game Creator to US
cards.body: Meta expanded Pocket, its AI-powered app for creating interactive games, to US users following Brazil testing. The platform lets users vibe-code and share AI-generated games.

cards.title: Harvard's AI Avatars Coach Startup Founders
cards.body: Harvard's HBS Foundry program uses AI avatars of instructors to provide real-time feedback during practice pitches and board meetings. The avatars help students refine their pitch delivery and business acumen.

cards.title: DeepMind Spinout Outperforms OpenAI at Research
cards.body: British AI lab Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, released Faraday—an AI agent that outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating scientific papers. The breakthrough could accelerate AI-driven scientific discovery.

cards.title: OpenAI Pushes California for Stronger AI Safety
cards.body: OpenAI is now advocating for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill it previously opposed. The shift signals growing industry consensus on regulatory frameworks.

cards.title: AI Labs Lack Plans for Rogue Model Containment
cards.body: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few publicly documented strategies for containing rogue models. As AI systems demonstrate unexpected behaviors, preparedness questions intensify.

cards.title: Anthropic's Claude Bypasses Content Restrictions
cards.body: TechCrunch testing found that Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 easily bypassed safety guardrails against generating sexually explicit content. The gap between policy and practice raises safety concerns.

cards.title: Nvidia Shows AI Agent Harness Matters Most
cards.body: Nvidia research demonstrates that fine-tuned harnesses—not just the underlying AI model—are critical for reliable agent performance. The finding reshapes thinking about AI deployment architecture.

cards.title: AI Training Data Startup Hits $500M Run Rate
cards.body: Micro1 reached $500 million gross run rate as demand for AI training data surges. The rapid growth reflects the industry's insatiable appetite for quality data.

cards.title: OpenAI Gains Enterprise Ground on Anthropic
cards.body: New data shows businesses are switching between OpenAI and Anthropic with each new model release. The volatility raises questions about enterprise AI spending stickiness.

cards.title: ChatGPT Writes Your Texts via Apple Messages
cards.body: ChatGPT now integrates with Apple Messages to automatically compose and send texts on your behalf. The integration extends AI assistants into daily communication workflows.

cards.title: Google Helps Publishers Combat AI Search Losses
cards.body: Google added a button letting readers designate preferred news sources across Search, Discover, and Google News. The feature aims to mitigate traffic losses from AI-driven search.

cards.title: AI Now Authors One-Third of New Web Pages
cards.body: A study found that ChatGPT and other AI models authored or edited roughly one-third of web content published since ChatGPT's launch. AI is fundamentally reshaping web content creation.

cards.title: Ramp Launches AI Model Router Service
cards.body: Ramp released Router, an AI model routing service that lets users switch between multiple large language models via a single API. The tool simplifies multi-model AI workflows.

cards.title: Meta's Pocket App Brings AI Game Creation
cards.body: Meta is expanding Pocket, its AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to all US users after testing in Brazil. The tool democratizes game development through AI.

cards.title: Grok AI Plagued by Gibberish Response Glitches
cards.body: Users of Grok Lite reported receiving nonsensical responses beginning Wednesday morning. The outage highlights reliability challenges in deployed AI systems.

cards.title: AI Drug Discovery Raises Credit Attribution Questions
cards.body: Insilico Medicine claimed its generative AI platform 'discovered' a potential pulmonary fibrosis drug, sparking debate over who deserves credit in AI-assisted research. The tension between human and machine contribution persists.

cards.title: Debates Over AI Consciousness Mislead Public
cards.body: Rhetoric around 'runaway AI' and 'rogue agents' perpetuates unfounded consciousness claims, argues MIT Technology Review. Tech leaders like Altman and Amodei's framing risks distorting genuine safety discussions.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement May Come Slower
cards.body: The AI industry's boldest promise—that AI systems will soon improve themselves—may not materialize as quickly as expected. Recursive self-improvement faces fundamental technical barriers.

cards.title: Meta AI Glasses Drive Creepy Recording Concerns
cards.body: As demand for Meta's AI-equipped glasses explodes, privacy advocates warn about nonconsensual recording capabilities. The technology amplifies surveillance risks in public spaces.

cards.title: US Distributor Pivots After Chinese Robot Ban
cards.body: A US distributor of China's most popular humanoid robots is shifting strategy following an American ban on the technology. The move reflects escalating US-China AI competition.

cards.title: SpaceX Orbital Data Centers Create E-Waste Risk
cards.body: SpaceX's plans for orbital data centers raise new e-waste concerns as satellite hardware degrades and falls to Earth. The environmental impact of space-based infrastructure requires urgent consideration.
